title: TaskHive — Enterprise-Grade Project Management API
description: A production-style enterprise backend system for team-based project and task management, built with a modular monolith architecture, real-time capabilities, async processing, and full observability stack.
results: Modular monolith architecture with decoupled domain boundaries and a strict service business logic tier, keeping long-term technical debt minimal
Stateless JWT authentication with social login (Google/GitHub) and fine-grained Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across multi-tenant team structures
Optimized PostgreSQL data layer with multi-column indexing, soft-deletion engine, transaction blocks, and Redis-driven cache invalidation — achieving P95 read latency under 100ms
Real-time WebSocket communication modules via Django Channels alongside Celery async background processing for task notifications and heavy workloads
Full observability stack with Prometheus metrics instrumentation and Grafana dashboards monitoring latency, throughput, and worker queue health
92%+ test coverage across 110+ unit and integration tests validated under load with Locust, achieving 0% error rate under simulated concurrent traffic
